property_summary: Only the current owner can change the owner via transferOwnership, so a call from any non-owner actor must leave c.owner() unchanged; the mutant lets anyone set the owner, so some fuzzed (actor, newOwner) pair changes the owner.
change_summary: Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so ownership transfers no longer require the caller to be the owner, allowing a non-owner to change the owner value.
